statements.impact_statement: The stack-exhaustion denial of service (CVE-2026-93687) requires evaluating deeply nested, attacker-controlled brace-expansion patterns. braces reaches N|Solid only inside the ncm-ng agent through fast-glob, and every glob pattern ncm-ng evaluates is hardcoded (workers/certifyNG/install-scripts.js and workers/general/getLocalModuleFilePaths.js match fixed patterns such as '**/*.js' under the user's own working directory). Adversarial brace patterns cannot reach braces through N|Solid, and braces has no patched release (every version <= 3.0.3 is affected), so an exemption is the only available remediation. Tracked in https://github.com/nodesource/nsolid-dependency-vuln-assessments/issues/2934.

npm audit flags micromatch only because its braces dependency is covered by CVE-2026-93687 / GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: the same advisory surfaced one level up the ncm-ng chain (micromatch -> braces). Exempted with the same rationale as the braces statement. Tracked in https://github.com/nodesource/nsolid-dependency-vuln-assessments/issues/2936.

npm audit flags fast-glob only because its micromatch dependency pulls braces, which is covered by CVE-2026-93687 / GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: the same advisory surfaced two levels up the ncm-ng chain (fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces). Exempted with the same rationale as the braces statement. Tracked in https://github.com/nodesource/nsolid-dependency-vuln-assessments/issues/2935.
